content: Prometrium® is a pharmaceutical product containing micronized progesterone, which is chemically identical to the progesterone naturally produced in a woman's body. It is manufactured by Solvay Pharmaceuticals and has been approved by the FDA for use in the United States. The progesterone in Prometrium® is synthesized from yams, ensuring its bioidentical nature. The inactive ingredients in Prometrium® capsules include peanut oil NF, gelatin NF, glycerin USP, lecithin NF, titanium dioxide USP, and coloring agents. Prometrium® is primarily prescribed for hormone replacement therapy (HRT), specifically bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT). The micronization process significantly enhances the absorption of progesterone when administered orally. Before the development of Prometrium®, micronized progesterone was only available through compounding pharmacies. However, its production as an FDA-approved prescription medication by a major pharmaceutical company has greatly improved its accessibility. While Prometrium® is most commonly taken orally in capsule form, it is also available as vaginal suppositories for alternative administration routes.
